name: @saizul/url-unfurl
description: Fetch a URL and get link-preview metadata like Slack and Discord show: title, description, image, favicon, Open Graph, Twitter cards, oEmbed and JSON-LD. SSRF-safe by default, with timeouts, byte limits and charset handling. Zero runtime dependencies.
author: Saizul Amin (https://github.com/saizul)

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/write-cjs-package.mjs
scripts.lint: biome lint src test scripts examples && npm run typecheck
scripts.format: biome format --write src test scripts examples
scripts.format:check: biome format src test scripts examples
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
